purpose: reproducible NEXT versions of the real pinned client, built from the pinned source with only CLIENT_VERSION changed (verifier/integration/next-build.mjs): the activated client in the cases that need a delegated client able to commit policies. Lab artifacts, never shipped; signed only with lab keys inside a test. Records are kept per base commit: `current` is rebuilt and compared on every strict run; older bases keep their recorded hashes (reproduced when they were current) so device-run reviews can identify the artifact those runs activated.
